Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by a significant bond sell-off pushing 10-year Treasury yields to new highs. This rising rate environment is a major headwind for your tech and chip names, as it makes future growth less valuable.

Your holdings: SOXL is a huge concern, down 58.39% with a "SELL" status on a leveraged product. SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is also down 38.05% and marked "NEW." Remember, margin amplifies these drops. QQQ, SMH, and QQQI are also flagged for "TRIM."

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields; their continued rise will pressure your portfolio. Also, the negative reaction to MongoDB's earnings despite strength suggests a fragile tech sentiment.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions in this challenging rate environment.
plays: Immediately review SOXL and SPAL stops. Given their leveraged nature and significant losses, these need urgent attention to prevent further decay and capital erosion.
Consider trimming QQQ, SMH, and QQQI to reduce overall tech exposure, especially with rising bond yields pressuring valuations.
CRWD is performing well (+19.57%) and has an "ACCUMULATE" scanner signal (entry 214.17-213.8, stop 212.84). If you're comfortable adding to winners, this could be an option.
